nom: Exuviance Gentle Daily Exfoliating Face Pads

segments.sensitive: The large majority of reviewers with sensitive, reactive, or allergy-prone skin, including some who react to salicylic acid or retinol, report no burning, redness, or irritation and describe the pads as unusually gentle; a couple of reviewers, however, say their skin became reactive or red, particularly when combined with other exfoliants or retinol, or when over-exfoliating with twice-daily use.
segments.dry: Most reviewers who mention dry or dull skin say the pads hydrate rather than strip, recommending them for dryness and flakiness without further dehydration, though one reviewer found daily use dried her skin out and switched to every other day.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one prone to bumps along the hairline in summer, report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and no new irritation with regular use.

concerns.aging: Two reviewers report visible improvement in fine lines after a few weeks of use, one adding that under-eye circles and overall skin texture also looked better.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the pads hydrate rather than dry the skin, several noting their moisturizer absorbs better afterward or that they need less of it; one reviewer, however, found daily use dried her skin out until she cut back to every other day.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness, stinging, or irritation, including several who are usually reactive to exfoliants; a few, however, report their skin turned red or reactive, especially when combined with retinol or other exfoliating products, and one reviewer's husband reported an allergic-type reaction.
concerns.spots: One reviewer using this on oily skin for three months reports a light reduction in pigmentation alongside clearer skin and fewer breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer clogged pores or breakouts with regular use, including some with sensitive or oily skin; a couple of others, however, say the pads caused new breakouts or made their problem areas worse, and one notes the pads do not prevent acne.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers managing oiliness, including one prone to shine and bumps along the hairline, report the pads helped keep breakouts and bumps at bay without adding oiliness themselves.

aspects.libelle: Jar keeps pads fresh, good value
Can leave a slight sticky residue

extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Pros: the application is easy using the pads and there's a lot of product on each pad. You could even cut each in half. Your skin will feel soft after. And they get the job done! Cons: they can be harsh on your skin. I was using them everyday and then switched to every other day because it was drying my skin out.

I am in LOVE with these Exfoliating Pads! I have used many different exfoliating products over the years but these very quickly became one of my favorites! These pads really are gentle yet they do exfoliate your skin just enough without being too harsh. They have a nice scent which isn't too strong, and the serum in the pads dries very quickly which is perfect so that I can follow them with the rest of my skincare products. I wash my face first and then use these pads on my face, neck, and upper chest and then apply my serums/creams after. I love how clean my face feels after using these, and they make my skin feel surprisingly soft! I have been using these Exfoliating Pads for a few weeks now and have noticed an improvement in my fine lines, under eye circles, and my overall skin texture seems much smoother as well! I am absolutely going to continue using these pads!

I have extremely sensitive skin and I am allergic to Salicylic Acid so I have to be careful about what I use. This is the first exfoliating product that has not resulted in itching or extreme redness.

extraits.titre: sensitive skin approved, def will repurchase
extraits.texte: this is a new favorite product for me. I got these for free in exchange for my honest review and am almost done with the whole container and definitely going to purchase once I'm close to running out, which is soon. I have sensitive skin and can't tolerate retinols, so I have to rely on other products like chemical exfoliants to keep my skin looking fresh. I've been loyal to a certain other brand's two step peel pads for YEARS, but this gave me similar results with less irritation. I've been using AM and PM, and my skin has looked much more glowy and radiant. I have not had any negative reaction even though I'm prone to hives and eczema. The product absorbs quickly but feels slightly tacky on your skin until you add your moisturizer. Also love that there's less waste due to the recyclable container and each pad isn't individually packaged.
Been using these for over 3 months now on my oily skin and have noticed a change: clearer skin, less breakouts, and lightly reduced pigmention. (I use it once a day before bedtime).

extraits.titre: Very hydrating for being an exfoliation products.
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My biggest concern with exfoliation products is that it will dry out my skin since I already have dry skin but these are very hydrating even with everyday use. I also feel like the size of the round is perfect for your face. I've been using 2 every night one for my face and one for my neck and arms to see if it can help with the texture there too. The pads don't feel rough on skin and they are strong so they don't rip apart either.
